data.one_liner: Base package for executing GraphQL queries, mutations, and subscriptions against a schema.
data.what_it_does: Executes GraphQL queries, mutations, and subscriptions against a defined schema with support for introspection. It operates without a framework or dart:mirrors, supporting AOT compilation and standard Dart execution. It also implements both graphql-transport-ws and subscriptions-transport-ws WebSocket protocols.
use_when: You need to build a GraphQL backend or server in Dart without relying on dart:mirrors.
You want to handle GraphQL subscriptions over WebSockets using standard stream channels.
avoid_when: You need an all-in-one HTTP server integration out of the box (requires a framework adapter like angel3_graphql).
You want automatic reflection-based object mapping without defining resolvers or using generators.
strengths: Framework-agnostic and compatible with AOT compilation.
Implements modern and legacy GraphQL WebSocket subscription protocols.
weaknesses: Does not include built-in HTTP handling out of the box.
Requires manual resolvers or a default field resolver when working with model objects instead of Maps.
